text:
Nora: Hey folks — I submitted my resignation yesterday, last day 2026-07-15. I'm based in Lisbon. Need clarity on benefits continuation (COBRA equivalent?), final paycheck timing, and how to return the company laptop (who covers shipping/customs?).
Maria-peopleops: Thanks Nora. We'll coordinate. Quick notes: payroll needs written last-day, benefits team will confirm local continuation options. We'll open offboard ticket.
Tom-hr: @Nora because you're international, US COBRA doesn't apply. We'll set benefits termination to end of your last month and offer the standard international separation guide. People Ops will check if we can provide a one-time bridging stipend for health while you transition.
AJ-it: For laptop return — we can generate a prepaid label for EU shipments via ShipIt. Need the asset tag + serial. Also confirm whether you want pickup or dropoff to a local courier. Customs: we'll include a company return note to avoid import fees.
Nora: Asset TAG: RW-PL-7832, serial SNL-00987. Prefer pickup next week (any weekday). Shipping label is great.
AJ-it: Got it. I'll schedule pickup Thu 7/16 unless you prefer earlier. Please pack with the included anti-static sleeve. We require device wipe after we receive it; do not factory reset unless asked.
Ethan-eng: For knowledge transfer — can you drop a short runbook for ongoing feature work? Even a 15-min pairing session would help. I'm available Tue/Wed mornings.
Nora: I'll create a 1-page runbook and schedule a 30-min sync Tue 7/7 10:00 CEST. Link to docs once done.
Maria-peopleops: Payroll: final paycheck and any accrued PTO payout will process on the standard payroll date following your last day (usually within 15 days). We'll confirm exact date with payroll and post here.
Tom-hr: Benefits ask: People Ops — can we offer a 60-day employer-paid bridge for local medical coverage? If not, confirm stipend amount we can offer.
Maria-peopleops: @tom-hr I'll check budget. Worst case we provide a 30-day stipend of up to 300 EUR. Will update by EOD Friday.
it-bot: Offboard ticket created: OFF-2026-1187 — assignees: aj-it, tom-hr, payroll. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OFF-2026-1187
AJ-it: Added pickup: FedEx EU pickup scheduled Thu 2026-07-16 AM. Tracking will be posted to the ticket.
Nora: Thanks everyone. One more — I have a company phone with an EU SIM. Do I return SIM or keep? It has personal contacts.
AJ-it: Keep the SIM if you want to keep personal number. We'll need the device back. If you remove SIM, confirm you removed accounts and 2FA tokens. If not, IT will handle token revocation centrally.
Maria-peopleops: Action items recap:
- People Ops: confirm benefits bridge or stipend by EOD Fri
- IT: shipping label + pickup (AJ)
- Payroll: confirm final pay date and PTO payout
- Nora: post runbook + attend KT slot Tue 7/7
We'll update OFF-2026-1187 as items close. :white_check_mark:
Nora: Appreciated. Please cc me on the ticket updates.
Maria-peopleops: Will do. Thanks Nora — we'll make this smooth.
